notes.title: Gravedigger Version Update Preview
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/bd2ce1a820e1d9d096dba40a1a53a152574dd873.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for your support. A version update for 'Gravedigger' is about to be released, adding the Qin Han background of 'Wanfei' and the time traveling plot of 'Touching the Golden School Captain'. The interactive gameplay of 'Wanfei' can be unlocked at the end of the plot. The expected update date is July 23rd. In case of uncontrollable factors, it will be postponed. Please stay tuned.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/3134610f9b910edc99f36f0d32855c16d051e5c4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/ecba72e9ba973214000a40a7208955569363f3de.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Announcement on June 28th
notes.content: [p]1. Challenge the BOSS Mirror Demon and increase the number of treasures obtained from 30 to 90[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/3ffd65b1f710f8285d6a2bd5d3624587ca50de48.png"][/img][/p][p]2. The unlocking time for all Bronze Sparrow Terrace beauties has been reduced: Zhenji 300 seconds, Daqiao 600 seconds, Xiaoqiao 900 seconds, and Fox Demon 1200 seconds. (New players immediately get this effect, while old players can get it by restarting the game)[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/d744bea9fa439a07741611eb717bab8e123e294c.png"][/img][/p][p]3. Challenge the BOSS Mirror Demon and increase the amount of money obtained[/p][p]4. Placed in the military camp, the amount of money obtained increases every 5 seconds[/p][p]5. Placed in the military camp, 100% treasure is obtained every 10 seconds. The higher the level of tomb raiding, the more treasures are generated each time placed. For example, level 2 receives 2 treasures every 10 seconds, level 3 receives 3 treasures every 10 seconds[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/6804ce384b5744595a3adb7ae6ca27f4fe56e3a4.png"][/img][/p][p]6. Attention: Each time you challenge the BOSS Mirror Demon, you can increase your tomb raiding level by 1 level[/p]

notes.title: Update Announcement on June 25th
notes.content: [p]1. The initial four dimensions of the Bronze Sparrow Terrace beauty have been increased to 90%[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/d18a4fab4a9daa543146d9189b14b23b19c55fb4.png"][/img][/p][p]2. Increased triggering probability of tomb treasures[/p][p]3. The triggering probability of Tomb Ghost Bride, Qiannu Ghost, White Clothed Ghost, and Luochanu increases[/p][p]4. After defeating the Tomb Mirror Demon BOSS, the total number of treasures rewarded increases from 10 to 30[/p][p]5. Fix BUG: Challenge Mirror Demon BOSS will no longer clear excess NSWE progress [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/f7157798fe8dbabbd935c1a9cda0516eab467378.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/ab8c03842d5b2db1fa8133c323de2296872ef100.png"][/img][/p]
